metadata.title: zzip - your music playground in the cloud, Soundcloud and Bandcamp Download
metadata.description: Zzip is your music playground in the cloud. Import SoundCloud playlists, Bandcamp albums, or upload MP3s. Build endless playlists, stream anywhere, and keep the beat alive.

hero.title: Create your Personal Music Playlist in the Cloud
hero.subtitle: Mix SoundCloud playlists, Bandcamp albums, and your own MP3s into one endless library. Build playlists, stream anywhere, and keep the beat alive.

features.title: Powerful Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to build and enjoy your music library.

cloud.title: Endless Tunes in the Cloud
cloud.description: Stack up thousands of tracks without worry. Your beats, albums, and playlists live safely in the cloud—ready to play anytime, anywhere.

stream.title: Plug & Play Imports
stream.description: Pull in playlists and albums straight from SoundCloud and Bandcamp. No hassle, just more music in your collection.

zip.title: Zip & Go
zip.description: Pack up your favorite playlists or your whole library into a neat ZIP and take them with you in one click.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Download content from SoundCloud and BandCamp in three simple steps.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about zzip

items.question: Is zzip legal to use?
items.answer: Yes, zzip is legal to use for personal content. However, always respect copyright laws and terms of service of the platforms you're downloading from.

items.question: How secure is my data?
items.answer: We use industry-standard encryption to protect your data. Your files are private and only accessible by you unless you choose to share them.

items.question: Can I download private content?
items.answer: No, zzip can only download publicly available content from Twitter and Instagram.

items.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes will be applied to your next billing cycle.
